claim: On a current-source eligible pre-camp site, a player can use native semantic World, dialogue, and camp-type menu owners to establish a new camp and then observe the actual resulting camp identity and assigned actor.
material_proof: A selected current-source run first records the fixture-derived nearby unassigned follower strictly as setup, then retains accepted native receipts through the advertised World/chat, actor-selection, follower dialogue, and camp-type menu path.  A post-establishment authoritative observation names the resulting camp's identity, owner and site together with the same actor's assigned-camp state.  The run has an accepted cleanup.
material_contradiction: an accepted player action lacks its matching native receipt
the chosen follower is inferred rather than identified, is already assigned, or is direct-mutated after launch
the site or offered camp type is inferred from presentation rather than current native state
the selected menu entry produces no resulting camp identity or a camp at a different site/owner
a selector opening, fixture transform, source inspection, physical key, OCR, screenshot, coordinate, callback, or direct save/NPC/camp mutation is credited as establishment
already_accepted_evidence: R-020 controlled camp setup is manufactured-state setup only.
R-026 Base Missions recovery proves a prepared-camp selector handoff only.
The historical R-009 physical/OCR camp footing is not current establishment proof.
current_uncertainty: The pre-camp fixture's derived follower and eligible terrain must be confirmed from the current native run, and the native dialogue may expose a different valid conversation/menu sequence than historical physical automation.  Mission, Food, Storage, Locker and Patrol behavior remain independent claims.
forbidden_shortcuts: physical keys, hotkeys, OCR, screenshots, coordinates, or guessed controls
direct NPC, camp, site, or save mutation after fixture install
crediting fixture installation, startup, setup follower presence, selector availability, or semantic acceptance without the resulting camp state
treating establishment as proof of mission, Food, Storage, Locker, or Patrol behavior
honest_stop_conditions: stop before launch if no active source-matched registry selection exists
after launch, preserve the first missing semantic owner, invalid eligibility, missing native receipt, or missing resulting camp identity and continue independent clean claims
seal the establishment claim only after the named postcondition and cleanup are cited
